title: Backyard Barbecue Designs to Elevate Your Outdoor Space
summary: From grilling stations to luxurious outdoor kitchens, we’ve curated a collection of backyard barbecue designs to inspire your outdoor living.
body_markdown:
Last updated on July 9th, 2026


Embrace the outdoors and indulge in the joys of backyard entertaining. Toll Brothers homes are beautifully designed with your lifestyle in mind. Our[expansive backyards](https://www.tollbrothers.com/blog/backyard-landscaping-ideas) provide space for a variety of activities, including grilling and hosting the ultimate dinner party with family and friends.


From innovative grilling stations to luxurious[outdoor kitchens](https://www.tollbrothers.com/blog/dream-outdoor-kitchen) , we’ve curated a collection of barbecue designs from our[California](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/California) communities to inspire your backyard lifestyle.


Explore six barbecue designs from our Toll Brothers model homes and get inspired to personalize your dream backyard space.


[Toll Brothers at Griffin Ranch in La Quinta, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Toll-Brothers-at-Griffin-Ranch)


## Elevate Your Backyard Barbecue Area With These Design Ideas:


## 1. California Living Inspired Backyard Barbecue Designs


[Regency at Tracy Lakes by Toll Brothers in Tracy, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Regency-at-Tracy-Lakes)


Elevate your entertaining experience with this stunning barbecue retreat that masterfully blends luxury and function. A generous dining table surrounded by woven chairs invites guests to hang out while their meal’s prepared at the sleek built-in grill and prep station. Anchored by a rustic linear stone fire pit, the space offers a warm, inviting centerpiece for gatherings that stretch into the evening.


## 2. Modern Backyard Barbecue Designs


[Toll Brothers in Summit at Orchard Hills in Irvine, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Toll-Brothers-in-Summit-at-Orchard-Hills)


Smoothly transition to your outdoor living space with this modern patio space. Whether hosting a gathering or enjoying a quiet evening meal, this sleek design blends functionality with style, creating a sophisticated ambiance that complements your outdoor lifestyle.


## 3. Garden Barbecue Designs


[Viewpoint at Metro Heights by Toll Brothers in Montebello, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Metro-Heights/Viewpoint)


This backyard barbecue design will transform your home into a garden oasis. By incorporating lush greenery into the space, every meal becomes a tranquil experience.


## 4. Culinary-Inspired Backyard Barbecue Ideas


[Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands in Valencia, CA](https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes-for-sale/California/Toll-Brothers-at-Tesoro-Highlands)


This modern covered patio is designed for effortless entertaining and elevated everyday living. At its heart is a fully equipped barbecue station, complete with a built-in grill – perfect for crafting gourmet meals in the open air.


## 5. Elevated Indoor-Outdoor Barbecue Designs


This sleek barbecue design pairs a stainless-steel grill and stone countertop with spacious dining and ambient pendant lighting. The seamless indoor-outdoor transition invites everyone outside for a casual weeknight dinner or a day-long festivity on the weekend.


## 6. Contemporary Backyard Barbecue Ideas


This contemporary barbecue design elevates your outdoor entertainment with an intimate atmosphere for enjoying food and camaraderie with guests. With black-accented structures and modern furniture, this space embodies luxury.


Visit our[Toll Brothers Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.com/tollbrothers/) page to explore more outdoor dream spaces that are sure to inspire your backyard design.
